items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I think Brett's dad played trombone, and the brother I'm speaking of -- his real name was William Woodman -- but he played tenor sax, and he's the one that was up north with me

ctx.x: Oh, yeah -- that's an interesting question, because the only one that you would know of -- we called him Brother Woodman, and his name was William Woodman, but he was Brett Woodman's brother, you know, the Woodman family here in Los Angeles were good musicians. I think

Brett's dad played trombone, and the brother I'm speaking of -- his real name was William Woodman -- but he played tenor sax, and he's the one that was up north with me, and, you know, we had -- it was just a good band, you know, wasn't nothing sensational about the band, but it was just a band that worked a lot.
